name: comp-427
title: Muted Background Tabs
blurb: Tabs with muted background styling on active state.
description: Tab variant with transparent background and muted active state. Active tab shows subtle background color without shadow.
use_when: Minimalist designs requiring subtle tab styling with muted colors.
avoid_when: When you need high contrast or pronounced active indicators.
a11y: Semantic tabs with keyboard navigation via radix-ui Tabs component.
